notice: Per-engagement control overlay. Copy this file, rename it for the engagement, and populate it from the client's actual framework document. Every identifier here must be transcribed from that document - never inferred, never guessed. Rules not listed keep only their baseline references. An overlay never changes what is tested or what result is produced; it only adds the client's own control identifiers alongside ours.

frameworks_declared.name: <framework name as printed on the client's document>
frameworks_declared.source_document: <file name or reference the assessor read>

additional_requirements.note: Record honestly where the toolkit does not cover a client requirement rather than stretching an existing rule to look like it does.
